_about: Reversed meanings moved off the decks on 2026-10-07 because no source for that deck gave them (PlayfulProcess: "I would delete any reverse meaning that was not there"). Kept by deck and item id. Written by scripts/archive/remove_unsourced_reversals.py.

reasons.tarot-de-marseille-conver: No source gives reversed meanings for the Marseille pattern: a game pack, meanings a post-1780s overlay (research/decks/tarot-de-marseille-conver.md, after Decker 1996 and Dummett 1980).
reasons.oswald-wirth-tarot: Wirth's own text (the `Wirth` sections) gives no reversed meanings; research/cards/oswald-wirth-tarot.md cites no source for them.
reasons.etteilla: Not Etteilla's: the pip lines were one template repeated across the four suits and the court lines ("the person ill-disposed") were invented; no source in the repo gives them.

major-00-le-mat.Reversed: Folly, heedlessness, dispersion; movement without direction or commitment.

major-01-le-bateleur.Reversed: Trickery, false starts, cleverness without substance, manipulation.

major-02-la-papesse.Reversed: Secrets misused, surface knowledge, withdrawal, sterile silence.

major-03-limperatrice.Reversed: Vanity, sterility, smothering, creativity blocked or squandered.

major-04-lempereur.Reversed: Domination, rigidity, tyranny, order hardened into oppression.

major-05-le-pape.Reversed: Dogma, empty orthodoxy, conformity, the letter without the spirit.

major-06-lamoureux.Reversed: Indecision, temptation, a union founded on weakness, choice deferred.

major-07-le-chariot.Reversed: Loss of control, conflict, a triumph undone by pride or haste.

major-08-la-justice.Reversed: Injustice, imbalance, severity, judgment distorted or evaded.

major-09-lhermite.Reversed: Isolation, withdrawal that avoids, a light hoarded or refused.

major-10-la-roue.Reversed: Bad turns, resistance to change, being dragged by the wheel.

major-11-la-force.Reversed: Brute force, domination by appetite, weakness disguised as control.

major-12-le-pendu.Reversed: Useless sacrifice, stagnation, martyrdom that serves no one.

major-13-la-mort.Reversed: Stagnation, fear of change, decay resisted instead of released.

major-14-temperance.Reversed: Imbalance, impatience, dissipation, the flow spilled or blocked.

major-15-le-diable.Reversed: Release from bondage, or deeper enslavement: obsession, the chains embraced.

major-16-la-maison-dieu.Reversed: Disaster resisted, a collapse delayed but coming, clinging to ruins.

major-17-letoile.Reversed: Despair, disillusion, hope clouded, the waters poured in vain.

major-18-la-lune.Reversed: Deception, fear, confusion, illusions mistaken for truth.

major-19-le-soleil.Reversed: Vanity, false brightness, a clouded sun, happiness only on the surface.

major-20-le-jugement.Reversed: Stagnation, a call refused, fear of change, the trumpet unheard.

major-21-le-monde.Reversed: Incompletion, a goal almost reached, a cycle that fails to close.

arcanum-00-le-fou.Reversed: Aimlessness, madness, dispersion of force; the spirit that scatters instead of advancing.

arcanum-01-le-bateleur.Reversed: Trickery, misused skill, a will turned to manipulation or empty cleverness.

arcanum-02-la-papesse.Reversed: Secrets misused, surface piety without depth, knowledge withheld or sterile.

arcanum-03-limperatrice.Reversed: Sterility, vanity, luxury without fruit, creative energy squandered.

arcanum-04-lempereur.Reversed: Tyranny, rigidity, domination, order hardened into oppression.

arcanum-05-le-pape.Reversed: Dogmatism, hollow orthodoxy, the letter of the law without its spirit.

arcanum-06-lamoureux.Reversed: Indecision, temptation, a union founded on weakness, choice avoided.

arcanum-07-le-chariot.Reversed: Loss of control, conflict between the forces, a triumph that turns to defeat through pride.

arcanum-08-la-justice.Reversed: Injustice, imbalance, severity without mercy, judgment distorted.

arcanum-09-lermite.Reversed: Isolation, miserliness with one's light, withdrawal that becomes mere avoidance.

arcanum-10-la-roue.Reversed: Bad luck, resistance to change, being dragged by the wheel rather than riding it.

arcanum-11-la-force.Reversed: Brute force, domination by appetite, weakness disguised as control.

arcanum-12-le-pendu.Reversed: Useless sacrifice, stagnation, a martyrdom that serves no one, attachment refusing to let go.

arcanum-13-la-mort.Reversed: Stagnation, fear of change, decay that is resisted instead of composted, mortification without renewal.

arcanum-14-la-temperance.Reversed: Imbalance, impatience, dissipation, the flow blocked or spilled.

arcanum-15-le-diable.Reversed: Liberation from bondage, or its opposite: deeper enslavement, obsession, the chains accepted as comfort.

arcanum-16-la-maison-dieu.Reversed: Disaster resisted, a delayed but inevitable collapse, clinging to ruins, catastrophe without learning.

arcanum-17-les-etoiles.Reversed: Despair, disillusion, hope clouded, the waters poured out in vain.

arcanum-18-la-lune.Reversed: Deception, fear, confusion mastering the traveller, illusions taken for truth.

arcanum-19-le-soleil.Reversed: Vanity, a clouded sun, false brilliance, happiness that is only on the surface.

arcanum-20-le-jugement.Reversed: Stagnation, a call refused, fear of change, the trumpet unheard.

arcanum-21-le-monde.Reversed: Incompletion, a goal almost but not reached, a cycle that fails to close, attachment to the journey instead of its end.
